Package eu.algites.pltf.modustro.builder.model.dependency.resolution

Class AIcDependencyTechnologyPlanEntry

java.lang.Object
eu.algites.pltf.modustro.builder.model.dependency.resolution.AIcDependencyTechnologyPlanEntry
public final class AIcDependencyTechnologyPlanEntry extends Object
One portable dependency or constraint translated into technology-native logical roles. Native usage values are stable bridge identifiers such as Gradle configuration names or Python dependency-environment roles. They intentionally do not expose Gradle API types.
